Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_FixConif: Canadian Hemlock drops pine cones when chopped down, on the same terms as Virginia Pine. The base game only gives cones to trees whose sprite name contains "pine", so Hemlock never drops any despite being a conifer. Turn this off to restore the base game's behaviour.
Sandbox_EeltsForestryRemastered_TreeGrow: Whether trees grow over time. The base game caps naturally spawned trees well below full size and drives their growth from a single world-wide counter, so forests never mature. Set this to the base game's behaviour to leave every tree alone.
How long a tree takes to grow, as a multiplier. At 1.0 a tree goes from a fresh sapling to the largest size in roughly three in-game months. Higher values take longer, lower values are faster.
